claim: Apple's net income was at least $39.0 billion in Q1 2024.
summary: Apple's net income in Q1 2024 was well below $39.0 billion whether Q1 is interpreted as fiscal Q1 2024 (~$33.9B) or calendar Q1 2024 (~$23.6B), contradicting the claim.

sub_claims.text: Apple's net income was at least $39.0 billion in Q1 2024.
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge: Apple fiscal Q1 2024 ended Dec 2023 net income was ~$33.9B; calendar Q1 2024 (fiscal Q2 2024) net income was ~$23.6B. Both are below $39B, so claim is false under either interpretation.
